name: Philip
overview: The name Philip appears in Scripture referring to distinct individuals with different roles and contexts. One Philip was the brother of Herod Antipas and husband to Herodias, involved in the events leading to John the Baptist's imprisonment, as noted in Matthew 14:3 and Mark 6:17. Another Philip served as tetrarch of Iturea and the region of Trachonitis during the reign of Tiberius Caesar, as recorded in Luke 3:1. Additionally, Philip is listed among Jesus' twelve apostles, mentioned in Matthew 10:3 and Mark 3:18, highlighting his role in the early ministry of Christ.
